title: Claude Code Skill Frontmatter
description: Schema for SKILL.md YAML frontmatter in Claude Code skills

description.description: What this skill does and when to activate it

argument-hint.description: Hint showing argument placeholders for user-invocable skills

allowed-tools.description: Tools this skill is allowed to use

model.description: Model to use when running this skill (e.g., opus, sonnet, haiku, inherit)

when_to_use.description: Additional guidance on when this skill should be activated

user-invocable.description: Whether this skill can be invoked directly by the user as a slash command

disable-model-invocation.description: Prevent the model from autonomously invoking this skill

agent.description: Sub-agent type to delegate execution to

paths.description: Glob patterns that conditionally activate this skill when matching files are touched

last_updated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the skill was last updated

update_policy.description: Policy governing how and when this skill should be updated

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata attached to the skill
